title.value: LAUGHING HYENA DISTILLERY: Extracting Compact Recurrences From Convolutions
title.justification: The paper introduces and discusses a method called 'Laughing Hyena Distillery' for creating compact state-space models from long convolution sequence models, aiming to improve memory efficiency and throughput during generation.
title.quote: In this paper, we seek to enable O(1) compute and memory cost per token in any pre-trained long convolution architecture...

extractions.description: The paper presents the Laughing Hyena Distillery method, which aims to extract compact recurrences from convolutional sequence models to improve the efficiency of autoregressive generation. This method employs state-space models to achieve constant memory and computational costs, allowing for more efficient processing and larger batch sizes during inference, without loss in quality. The approach involves techniques like rational interpolation and model-order reduction, achieving significant improvements in throughput over existing models such as Transformers and Hyena.

primary_category.justification: The paper focuses on improving computational efficiency which is indirectly linked to climate change mitigation efforts by potentially reducing the carbon footprint of deep learning models used in various applications.
primary_category.quote: Efficiency Our distillation methods for constant-memory, high throughput inference in long convolution sequence models (LCSMs) can lead to energy savings during model deployement, enabling processing of longer-form content at a fraction of the cost and reducing environmental impact.

applications.value: High-efficiency autoregressive generation in language models
applications.justification: The paper proposes methods that significantly enhance the efficiency of autoregressive generation processes in language models, which could lessen the environmental impact by decreasing energy consumption in data centers.
applications.quote: In auto-regressive workloads, LaughingHyena-distilled models with state dimension d can generate K tokens in O(dK) time and with constant O(d) memory.

new_primary_category.justification: The paper's focus on reducing computation and memory overhead in deep learning inference suggests a category focused on computational efficiency in ML applications.
